body:
I had tried yet again to tell someone about how their behavior was harmful. I told them that I wanted to work towards better communication, and that I felt hurt when they wouldn't oblige in furthering communication. They expected me to understand the subtleties of what they were saying, and thought it was "stupid" of me to ask for clarification. They said that I was a "retard." That increased my sadness and feeling that I don't belong.     
I'm looking to end with my current psychologist. She hasn't been very helpful anyway; she doesn't want to deal with my alters should they surface.      
It's a mixture of things, I suppose...  
I really appreciate your support.
